messages:
Maya: Heads-up: a competitor launched per-route cost routing. Acme is asking if we can match. Need quick triage.
Jordan: Can we scope a minimal solution?
Priya: Sales wants an ETA for renewal. Narrow proposal only — keep differentiators.
Alex: Technical MVP: API flag + backend policy that picks model by tenant/cost. No UI initially.
Jordan: If we can reuse policy hooks, estimate ~5 working days incl. rollout.
Sam: Product guardrail: don't erode our latency guarantees. Define launch criteria.
Maya: Proposed criteria: p95 decision <60ms, API contract stable, billing flag, support runbook.
ops-bot: Maintenance window 03:00 UTC available for risky deploys.
Priya: Sales asks for demo — design can mock a single toggle and flow in 48h.
Jordan: Spike owners: Jordan + Alex. ETA 72h. If spike shows reuse, greenlight narrow Hosted beta limited to top-tier customers.
Maya: Decision rule: spike <=5d and perf targets feasible -> ship narrow MVP; otherwise push to Q4.
Sam: Messaging suggestion: "cost-aware routing controls" to lead with control, not copycat.
Alex: Quick spike config to test:
policy.selector=tenant_id;policy.strategy=prefer_low_cost;policy.fallback=baseline;policy.ttl=60s
Jordan: I'll post spike results here.
Maya: Add to checklist: SLOs, docs, billing flag, rollout knobs, quality metrics.
Priya: I'll draft FAQ and negotiation anchors for Sales.
Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
